$comment: The Crate Yard (Q1.4, Anders): push each crate onto a plate of its kind. The yard's grid, its plates and where each crate starts are the game's (src/world/sites/crate-yard-logic.ts: the crates fill its slots in this order); what's on each crate, which plate it belongs on (chat: the tavern side; project: the slipway), why, and the plates' signs are this file's. For the Copilot app course, 01 · Chats, Project Sessions, and Modes: a chat for questions and brainstorming, a project session when the agent needs your repository.

label: Ask a quick
question
items.why: A quick question doesn’t need your repository. Ask it in a chat.

label: Fix a bug
in the repo
items.why: Fixing a bug changes code in your repository. That needs a project session.

label: Brainstorm
ideas
items.why: Brainstorming is exploring. A chat makes no branch or worktree, and it doesn’t need one.

label: Add a test
for search
items.why: Adding a test edits code in your repository. That’s project work.

label: Explain
worktrees,
in general
items.why: That’s a general question. It doesn’t need your repository, so ask it in a chat.

label: Open a
pull request
items.why: A pull request is made from your repository. Start a project session.

label: Tour the
book app
(no edits)
items.why: No files change, but it needs your repository. That’s a project session.

text.undoHint: Pushed one the wrong way? Press Z (LB on a gamepad) to take it back.
text.nothingToUndo: No push to take back. The lever by the gate starts over.
text.stepAside: Step out of the way, Captain, so the crate can slide back.
text.finishWithAnders: Talk to Anders to finish up at the shipyard.
text.hint1: Read each crate, Captain. Does the agent need your repository for this job?
text.hintJammed: That yard’s jammed, Captain. Pull the lever by the gate to start it over.
text.hint2: Try the glowing crate next. Which plate does its job belong on?
text.hint3: There, I’ve pushed one for you. Keep going!
